indicator_name: GDP and GVA volume index by section for the discrete quarter, same quarter of previous year = 100 (derived from year-to-date data)
description: ИФО ВВП и ВДС по видам деятельности за отдельный квартал, к тому же кварталу прошлого года (выведено из нарастающих итогов)
unit: % of the same quarter of the previous year
methodology: Derived from GVA_VOLUME_INDEX_BY_SECTION_QUARTERLY and GVA_NOMINAL_BY_SECTION_QUARTERLY: I_k = (I_ytd,k·N_ytd,k,t−1 − I_ytd,k−1·N_ytd,k−1,t−1)/(N_ytd,k,t−1 − N_ytd,k−1,t−1), previous-year prices. Gives the latest quarter before BNS's quarterly accounts (QNA_* end at 2026 Q1 on 2026-09-27; their Q2 is due with element 283161 on 28.10.2026). Rounding band about ±0.15 pp for GDP; Q4 carries the annual-survey residual of table 4439; the 4439/4440 basis differs from the QNA basis -- do not splice without a note. 2026 Q2: GDP 105.2.
